The color depth in bits of a display mode.
@param mode  The mode number, from 1 to [CountGfxModes](CountGfxModes).
@returns The depth in bits, always 32.
@gap A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
@gap Palette and 16 bit modes are not supported, so every mode is listed with 32 bits however the display could show it.
